title: Page 9
content_zh:
他本以为自己这辈子再也见不到妹妹了，没想到戚家派人找到了他，告诉他妹妹现在正在京城的戚家里，他毫不犹豫地立刻跟随戚家人来到京城，希望他们说的是真的，他的妹妹真的还好好的活在这个世界上。
「哥，对不起，让你担心了……」樊若柳也跟着红了眼眶。
「说什么对不起，你能平安就好……」
兄妹好不容易久别重逢，肯定有很多话想说，戚无秋淡淡一笑，领着丫鬟暂时退出房内，留给他们兄妹一个空间，能够好好的畅谈一番。
事情都一件件地解决妥当，接下来该处理的……就是薛少岗了！
戚无秋扬起一抹嗜血的笑容，他要是不好好的给薛少岗一顿好看，他就不叫戚无秋！
「你们快点放我走，我的伯父可是祈年县的县令，和不少官员交好，让我伯父知道你们软禁我，他绝对会要你们好看的！」
薛少岗一被无戚镖局的镖师抓住后，就被逮回京城，暂时软禁在镖局里，等候处置。
他被关在一间简陋的房子里已经好几天了，非常火大，拚命捶打被锁上铁链的房门。「我要出去，快让我出去！」
他拚命捶打，打得自己的手都痛死了，本以为外头看守他的人还是像以往一样对他不理不睬，没想到这次却出现开锁链的声音，好像终于要放他出去了。
他狰狞低一笑，只要他一回到祈年县，他一定要伯父给他们好看，替他报仇！
就在薛少岗的期待下，门终于了。」
「这是什么意思？」他顿时心生警戒，因为镖师脸上的笑容很不寻常。
「等你到了前厅，你就知道是什么意思了。」
他被镖师押着来到大厅里，一进到大厅，里头除了戚无秋和几名镖师之外，还有另一名眼熟的中年男子也在，一看到那男子出现，他马上兴奋地扬起笑容，觉得自己终于有救了。
「伯父！」他挣脱镖师的箝制，开心地往薛县令走去。「伯父，你是来救——」
「薛少岗，你给我跪下！」薛县令瞬间板起脸，怒斥出声。
「伯父？」薛少岗错愕地一顿，不明白现在到底是怎么一回事。
「我叫你跪下，你是没听到吗！」
气氛非常的不对劲，薛少岗不敢再造次，虽然非常不情愿，还是依照伯父的命令跪了下来。

第9章(2)
在薛少岗跪下之后，薛县令赶紧对坐在椅上喝茶的戚无秋讨好地笑着。「戚三公子，下官保证，往后绝对会好好的管教这个侄子，不会让他再继续为非作歹，请再给下官一次机会，绝对不会再有类似的事情发生了！」
戚无秋瞧了频冒冷汗的薛县令一眼，终于冷冷一笑，话语中的威胁意味十分浓厚。「薛县令，我请你过来看看你的侄子到底做了些什么『好事』，可不是想听你说这些不痛不痒的话，难道你还不明白吗？」
薛县令一咬牙，终于狠下心肠回答：「一百大板够不够？如果不够的话，还可以再往上……」
「伯父，你要打我？」薛少岗不敢置信地大呼出声。
「你给我闭嘴！」薛县令愤怒地斥责他。「你差点就害了樊若柳姑娘一条性命，打你这一百大板还算是轻的了，认命吧！」
戚家财大势大，只要他们靠关系拿些钱去疏通上位者，他头上这顶乌纱帽随时都有可能会被摘下来，为了保住他的官位，他也只能牺牲侄子了。
谁教侄子捅出这么大的一个楼子，还惹上不该惹的人，就必须承担这样的后果！
为免戚无秋还不满意，要继续往上加，薛县令赶紧命令随着自己过来的官差，准备「大义灭亲」。「来人，马上给我杖打他一百大板，而且绝对不能手下留情！」
「是！」官差虽然感到讶异，因为从前不管薛少岗犯了什么错，薛县令都不会责罚他，但既然县令都发下命令，他们当然还是照办。
「啊——啊——」薛少岗趴在地上，被打得痛叫出声，这一百大板打下去，他没死也会去掉半条命呀！
他痛得冷汗不停地流，没想到戚家人竟然有办法让伯父如此战战兢兢，还不惜打他一百大板以示惩戒，完全不管他到底受不受得了，就怕得罪了戚家。
薛县令管不得薛少岗凄惨的哀号声，要手下继续打，打完了才能停手，然后边流冷汗边小心的询问戚无秋。「三公子，这样你……还满意吗？」
「马马虎虎啦。」他故意摆出一脸不太满意的表情。
薛县令一惊，紧张地再度命令道：「那……再用力一点打、再更用力——」
「啊——」
听着薛少岗「美妙无比」的惨叫声，戚无秋微微勾起嘴角，悠闲惬意地继续喝茶，替自己和草儿感到爽快无比，终于狠狠地报了仇！
他可不会笨到自己亲手动用私刑，让薛少岗有抓住他任何把柄的机会，当然是将薛县令给「请」来京城，要薛县令亲自制裁自己的侄儿，让薛少岗吃一顿大瘪。
这就叫做借刀杀人之计，既不会脏了他自己的手，也能达到报仇的目的，他何乐而不为！
在戚家养病的日子，是樊若柳感到最幸福快乐的时刻。

因为不只有戚无秋疼她、宠她，连她哥哥也留下来陪伴她，两个她生命中最重要的男人将她照顾得无微不至，她觉得自己已经是全天下最好命的女人。
因为她有伤在身，不适合远行回乡，而戚家人也殷勤地留她下来疗伤，妥善地提供一切需要的帮助，哥哥也答应陪她一起留在戚家照顾她，希望她能快快好起来。
而且戚家其他公子对她也很好，根本早就把她当自家人看待了，大公子甚至直接戏称她为「三弟妹」，害她怪难为情的。
她像是突然多了很多的家人，这让她的心被喜悦所填满，脸上始终都漾着笑，心情非常的好。
「呼，天气真好……」
坐在戚家花园内的凉亭里，樊若柳一脸轻松惬意地瞧着园内景色，好好放松一下，之前养病一整天待在房里，都快将她给闷坏了，再不出来透口气，就怕她手上的伤还没好，又被闷出个病来。
在她瞧着花朵发愣时，男人无声地从后朝她逼近，非常亲密地将她给搂抱在怀中，在她耳旁低问：「在想什么，嗯？」
「无秋？」她微偏过头，看着背后的男人，漾起甜美带羞的笑颜。「你今天这么早就从镖局回来了？」
「没有什么太重要的事，当然要早点回来陪你。」他摸摸她越显红润的脸蛋，满意地笑着。「肉都补回来了，真好，这样才是我可爱又甜美的草儿呀！」
她前一阵子消瘦的模样，看得他真是心疼极了，幸好这阵子他吩咐厨子煮了一堆可以补身的药膳给她吃，她的气色也渐渐变得红润起来。
「不补回来行吗？你们简直是把我当猪一样照三餐在喂，我撑都快撑死了。」她忍不住瞪了他一眼，故意抱怨，现在的她不是吃就是睡，再过不久肯定被他们养成一只大肥猪。
「有吗？我瞧瞧？」他上上下下左左右右都瞧了一圈，之后才哄着她。「你才一点都不像猪，就算真的变成猪，也绝对会是一只最可爱的猪，让人舍不得吃，只想好好疼惜。」
「你……还真是越来越会花言巧语了。」她抱怨归抱怨，脸上甜美的笑容却泄漏了她真正的心思，其实她开心得很。
content_en:
He thought he would never see his sister again in this life, but he didn't expect that the Qi family sent someone to find him and told him that his sister was now at the Qi family in the capital. He immediately followed the Qi family to the capital without hesitation, hoping that what they said was true and that his sister was still alive and well in this world.
"Brother, I'm sorry for making you worry..." Fan Ruoliu also had red eyes.
"I'm sorry, I wish you were safe..."
The brother and sister finally reunited after a long separation. There must be a lot to say. Qi Wuqiu smiled lightly and led the maid out of the room temporarily, leaving the brother and sister a space to have a good talk.
Everything has been settled one by one, and the next thing to deal with is Xue Shaogang!
Qi Wuqiu raised a bloodthirsty smile. If he didn't give Xue Shaogang a good meal, he wouldn't be called Qi Wuqiu!
"Hurry up and let me go. My uncle is the magistrate of Qinian County and has good relations with many officials. If my uncle knows that you are putting me under house arrest, he will definitely make you look good!"
As soon as Xue Shaogang was caught by the bodyguards of Wuqi Escort Bureau, he was taken back to the capital and temporarily placed under house arrest in the Escort Bureau, waiting for disposal.
He had been locked up in a simple house for several days. He was very angry and beat the chained door desperately. "I want to get out, let me out quickly!"
He beat his hands so hard that they were painful to death. He thought that the people guarding him outside would ignore him as before, but unexpectedly, there was the sound of the chains being opened this time, as if they were finally letting him out.
He smiled ferociously, as soon as he returned to Qinian County, he would definitely ask his uncle to look good on them and avenge him!
Just as Xue Shaogang expected, the door finally opened. "
"What does this mean?" He suddenly felt wary because the smile on the escort's face was unusual.
"When you get to the front hall, you'll know what it means."
He was escorted by the bodyguards to the hall. As soon as he entered the hall, in addition to Qi Wuqiu and several bodyguards, there was another middle-aged man who looked familiar. As soon as he saw the man appear, he immediately smiled excitedly, feeling that he was finally saved.
"Uncle!" He broke free from the escort's grasp and happily walked towards Magistrate Xue. "Uncle, you are here to save——"
"Xue Shaogang, kneel down!" Magistrate Xue suddenly turned serious and shouted angrily.
"Uncle?" Xue Shaogang was stunned, not understanding what was going on now.
"I told you to kneel down, didn't you hear me?"
The atmosphere was very wrong, and Xue Shaogang did not dare to do it again. Although he was very reluctant, he still knelt down according to his uncle's order.
Chapter 9(2)
After Xue Shaogang knelt down, Magistrate Xue quickly smiled fawningly at Qi Wuqiu, who was sitting in a chair drinking tea. "Mr. Qi, I promise that I will discipline this nephew well in the future and will not let him continue to do evil. Please give me another chance. Nothing like this will ever happen again!"
Qi Wuqiu glanced at Magistrate Xue who was sweating frequently, and finally smiled coldly, the threat in his words was very strong. "Mr.
Magistrate Xue gritted his teeth and finally answered with determination: "Is one hundred big boards enough? If not, you can go higher..."
"Uncle, you want to hit me?" Xue Shaogang shouted in disbelief.
"Shut up!" Magistrate Xue scolded him angrily. "You almost killed Miss Fan Ruoliu, so a hundred thousand blows to you is considered a light blow. Just accept your fate!"
The Qi family has great wealth. As long as they rely on their connections to use money to connect with those in power, the black gauze hat on his head may be taken off at any time. In order to keep his official position, he can only sacrifice his nephew.
Who taught my nephew to poke such a big thing?If you mess with someone you shouldn't mess with in a building, you must bear the consequences!
In order to prevent Qi Wuqiu from being dissatisfied and continuing to increase the number, Magistrate Xue quickly ordered the officials who followed him to prepare to "exterminate relatives for justice." "Come here, give him a hundred blows with my stick right away, and you won't be merciful!"
"Yes!" Although the officials were surprised, because no matter what mistakes Xue Shaogang made in the past, Xue County Magistrate would not punish him, but since the county magistrate issued the order, of course they still followed it.
"Ah - ah -" Xue Shaogang lay on the ground and screamed in pain. If he was beaten with a hundred big boards, half of his life would be taken away even if he didn't die!
He was so painful that he was sweating non-stop. He didn't expect that the Qi family could find a way to make his uncle so frightened, and even slapped him with a hundred sticks as punishment. They didn't care whether he could bear it or not, for fear of offending the Qi family.
Magistrate Xue couldn't care less about Xue Shaogang's pitiful wailing, and asked his men to continue beating him until the beating was over. Then he carefully asked Qi Wuqiu while sweating coldly. "Third Young Master, are you...satisfied with this?"
"It's just so-so." He deliberately put on a dissatisfied expression.
Magistrate Xue was startled and nervously ordered again: "Then... hit harder, hit harder -"
"Ah——"
Listening to Xue Shaogang's "incomparably beautiful" screams, Qi Wuqiu raised the corners of his mouth slightly and continued to drink tea leisurely. He felt extremely happy for himself and Cao'er, and finally got his revenge!
He would not be stupid enough to personally lynch himself, giving Xue Shaogang a chance to seize any leverage against him. Of course, he would "invite" Magistrate Xue to the capital, and ask Magistrate Xue to punish his nephew personally, so that Xue Shaogang would suffer a big blow.
This is called the strategy of killing with a borrowed knife. It will not dirty his own hands, but it can also achieve the purpose of revenge. Why wouldn't he do it!
The days of recuperation at Qi's house were the happiest moments for Fan Ruoliu.
Because not only did Qi Wuqiu love and pamper her, but her brother also stayed with her. The two most important men in her life took good care of her, and she felt that she was already the most blessed woman in the world.
Because she was injured, she was not suitable to travel back to her hometown. The Qi family also graciously allowed her to stay here to recover from her injuries, and provided all the necessary help. Her brother also agreed to stay with her at the Qi family to take care of her, hoping that she would get well soon.
Moreover, the other young masters of the Qi family were also very kind to her and treated her as one of his own. The eldest young master even jokingly called her "third younger brother and sister", which made her feel embarrassed.
She seemed to suddenly have a lot more family members, which filled her heart with joy. She always had a smile on her face and was in a very good mood.
"Phew, the weather is so nice..."
Sitting in the pavilion in the garden of Qi's house, Fan Ruoliu looked at the scenery in the garden with a relaxed and contented face, relaxing. She had been suffocated by staying in the room all day to recuperate. If she didn't come out to take a breath, she was afraid that the injury on her hand would not heal yet and she would become sick again.
When she was looking at the flowers in a daze, the man silently approached her from behind, hugged her very intimately, and whispered in her ear: "What are you thinking about, huh?"
"Wu Qiu?" She tilted her head slightly, looked at the man behind her, and smiled sweetly and shyly. "You came back from the escort agency so early today?"
"It's nothing too important. Of course I have to come back early to stay with you." He touched her increasingly rosy cheeks and smiled with satisfaction. "The flesh has been replenished. It's great. This is my cute and sweet grass!"
She looked so thin a while ago, which really made him feel distressed. Fortunately, he asked the cook to cook a bunch of nourishing medicinal meals for her to eat, and her complexion gradually became rosy.
"Is it okay if you don't make up for it? You are just treating me like a pig and feeding me three meals a day. I am almost exhausted." She couldn't help but glare at him and complained deliberately., now she is either eating or sleeping, and they will definitely turn her into a big fat pig in the near future.
"Is there any? Let me take a look?" He looked around, up and down, left and right, and then coaxed her. "You don't look like a pig at all. Even if you really turn into a pig, you will definitely be the cutest pig that people won't want to eat. They just want to take good care of you."
"You... are really becoming more and more sweet-talking." She complained, but the sweet smile on her face revealed her true thoughts. In fact, she was very happy.
